## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Energy, Financials). Confirmation: very weak sector breadth and broad mega-cap Tech weakness (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/META BELOW TREND) while Energy and Financials show pockets of strength; style: mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +4.02% | 1M: +20.39%) ABOVE TREND. Financials follow: WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, MS (1W: +4.26% | 1M: -7.40%) RECOVERY, GS (1W: +4.00% | 1M: -10.78%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: CEG (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND, EXC (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -1.10%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -15.24%) BELOW TREND. Materials/Industrials soft: FCX (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -16.75%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%) RECOVERY, SLB (1W: +4.27% | 1M: -9.53%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt (Energy + Financials confirmed).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CEG (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -8.59%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -3.39%) BELOW TREND, EXC (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -1.10%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Utilities, Healthcare and Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY. Major divergence: multiple large-cap cyclical/tech names show 1W up vs 1M down (RECOVERY), while mega-cap Tech (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/META) remain BELOW TREND — tactical uncertainty, watch for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak; many large caps BELOW TREND: AAPL (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -4.83%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.46% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.06% | 1M: -7.96%) BELOW TREND, while chip equipment and select semi names RECOVERY: LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%) RECOVERY; sector performance: Technology 1W: -0.75% (24 stocks) — internal rotation, watch for follow-through.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cautious stabilization with short-term strength: JPM (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -6.98%) RECOVERY, WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, MS (1W: +4.26% | 1M: -7.40%) RECOVERY; Financials 1W: +0.84% (20 stocks) — part of the two positive sectors, favor selective Financial exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Broad weakness: JNJ (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -2.30% | 1M: -4.21%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND despite bullish news flow; sector 1W: -2.47% (17 stocks) — defensive names not leading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy and Financials exposure while reducing exposure to large-cap Tech that remains BELOW TREND; monitor RECOVERY names (LRCX/AMAT/AMD) for confirmation before re-adding to core positions. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt, but keep allocations nimble given major divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY — watch volume follow-through. BEARISH: LLY (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -12.58% | 1M: -23.45%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +10.31%) — Breadth part of the 2/11 positives. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -3.80%) and Materials (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -10.87%) — watch for widening weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -4.06% | 1M: -7.96%) BELOW TREND — a sustained weekly recovery above recent short-term highs would be needed to signal stabilization. XOM (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND — hold weekly momentum to extend sector leadership. LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY — weekly close above this week’s high confirms follow-through. JPM (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -6.98%) RECOVERY — needs consecutive weekly gains to convert to ABOVE TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+60): LLY (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND — news (China commitment) is bullish but price is diverging (distribution), watch if sentiment drives a recovery. MDT (+80): price not in snapshot for dual timeframe confirmation here but news-clearing FDA is a constructive catalyst to monitor. INTU (+55): price not in snapshot for dual timeframe confirmation; analyst upgrade is supportive for short-term momentum.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CEG (-50): CEG (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND — negative target cuts coincide with price weakness (confirmation). GOOGL (-45): GOOGL (1W: -0.42% | 1M: -0.54%) BELOW TREND — regulatory risk is a catalyst and price shows limited reaction (watch for follow-through). XOM (-45): XOM (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines on Iranian strikes are diverging vs price strength; monitor for macro-driven volatility.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy and Financials showing strength amid very weak breadth (2/11 sectors positive). OXY and COP ABOVE TREND and LRCX/AMAT/AMD showing short-term RECOVERY while mega-cap Tech (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/META) remain BELOW TREND. Key risk: major divergence between recovering cyclical/SMID names and entrenched mega-cap Tech weakness, plus mixed sentiment signals (LLY bullish but price falling) — watch for confirmation before shifting core allocations.
